title: O roteiro da viagem
grammarPoint: Be going to for plans and predictions

text.title: Our Week in California
paragraphs: Next month, my wife Julia and I are going to spend a week in California. It's our first [[road trip]] in the United States, so we planned everything carefully. Here is our itinerary.
We're going to land in San Francisco on Saturday. On Sunday, we're going to ride a [[cable car]] and walk across the Golden Gate Bridge. Julia is going to take a lot of photos, I'm sure!

On Monday, we're going to [[rent]] a car and drive south along the coast. We aren't going to drive at night, because the road has a lot of [[curves]]. We're going to stop in small towns and eat fresh seafood.
On Thursday, we're going to arrive in Los Angeles. Are we going to visit Hollywood? Of course! But we're also going to relax on the beach.
The [[weather forecast]] says sunny days all week, so it's going to be hot. We're packing [[sunscreen]], hats and sunglasses. I think it's going to be the trip of our lives!

cable car.note: Os bondinhos de São Francisco são famosos no mundo todo.

grammar.title: Be going to: planos e previsões
explanation: Usamos be going to + verbo básico para falar de planos e intenções: coisas que já decidimos fazer. We're going to rent a car (vamos alugar um carro). É muito parecido com o nosso "vou fazer".
A forma é am, is ou are + going to + verbo básico: I'm going to travel, she's going to take photos, we're going to land.
Na negativa: we aren't going to drive at night, she isn't going to work. Na pergunta, am, is ou are vêm antes do sujeito: Are we going to visit Hollywood?
Também usamos going to para previsões quando vemos uma evidência agora: a previsão diz sol, então it's going to be hot. Look at those clouds! It's going to rain.
Nas séries, você vai ouvir gonna: "I'm gonna call you". É a pronúncia informal de going to. Na escrita, use going to.

exercises.prompt: Em que cidade eles vão chegar de avião?
exercises.explanation: O texto diz: "We're going to land in San Francisco on Saturday."

exercises.statement: They are going to drive at night.
exercises.explanation: Falso: "We aren't going to drive at night".

exercises.prompt: Por que eles não vão dirigir à noite?
options: Porque a estrada tem muitas curvas
exercises.explanation: O texto diz: "because the road has a lot of curves".

exercises.statement: Julia is going to take a lot of photos.
exercises.explanation: Verdadeiro: "Julia is going to take a lot of photos, I'm sure!"

exercises.sentence: On Monday, we ___ rent a car.
exercises.explanation: Com we, usamos are going to (ou a contração we're going to).

exercises.sentence: Julia ___ going to work during the trip.
exercises.explanation: Com she (Julia), a negativa é isn't going to.
Na pergunta, are vem antes do sujeito: Are you going to...?

exercises.prompt: Você vê nuvens escuras no céu. O que você diz?
exercises.explanation: Previsão com evidência (as nuvens): it's going to rain.

exercises.prompt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa.
exercises.explanation: Sujeito + be going to + verbo básico: We're going to relax on the beach.
